name: Restaurant Social Commerce Engine
description: Custom MCP server pointing at the restaurant-social-commerce-engine API. Supports product draft creation and order reads. All write capabilities require an approval_token minted by skills/approval-gate.skill.json.

capabilities.name: product.create
capabilities.description: Create a TikTok Shop product draft (title, description, images, price, category). Always created in 'draft' status, never published.

capabilities.name: product.publish
capabilities.description: Move a product draft to live/published status.
capabilities.notes: Not called by any current skill. Reserved for explicit owner-initiated publish actions outside the automated routine.

capabilities.name: orders.read
capabilities.description: Read order history and conversion data for reporting.

capabilities.name: payments.charge
capabilities.description: Not used by this agent. Present only for completeness of the commerce engine API surface; must remain disabled unless explicitly enabled by the owner.

payment_processor.notes: Only referenced by the commerce engine for existing checkout flows; this agent never initiates charges.

sandbox_mode.notes: Use sandbox_base_url when validating the end-to-end approval flow (draft -> ping -> approve -> product created) before pointing at production.
